question: What's new on Raymond James in the last 90 days?
reasoning_content:
The sub-question asks: What guidance or forward outlook has Raymond James provided?

We need to find forward-looking statements/guidance. Passages: RJF-TRADE-2026-11-05-IN-01#0: "the firm has signaled it expects continued momentum, with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments heading into the coming year." That's an outlook. Also LJ-TRADE-2026-11-12-WM-01#0: advisors expected to transition in May 2027 — a forward statement but about transition timing, not guidance. May be a fact about forward outlook? It's a plan/expectation. Hmm.

Also RJF-TRADE-2026-09-29-IN-01#4 mentions strategy; conference signals more to come. But no explicit guidance figures.

The sub-question asks about guidance/forward outlook. The best item: "the firm has signaled it expects continued momentum, with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments heading into the coming year" — no figure, period coming year, scope advisor recruiting.

Any guidance like revenue/EPS guidance? None. Not disclosed? But there is a forward outlook statement. I'd label fact with the one item.

Also the Synovus advisor transition in May 2027 is an expectation (forward-looking) but it's a plan not guidance. Could include as a second item? The sub-question is "guidance or forward outlook." A statement of expected transition timing is arguably forward outlook. I'll include it cautiously as fact? Hmm, risk. The instruction: "Positions others hold about the future (executives, analysts, surveys) are facts when the passage attributes and dates them." The May 2027 transition is attributed to firm. I'll include as a fact item with period 2027-05 (not a valid format though; period formats are YYYY-MM-DD etc). Could use "2027-05" — not allowed. Maybe leave period "" and scope Financial Institutions Division. Actually a point in time... "2027-05-01"? That would be inventing. Better use "" period.

I think one item is safer for the guidance item. But adding the transition gives extra evidence; but it may be considered not guidance. I'll include only the momentum statement as fact.

Label: fact.

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James has signaled it expects continued momentum, with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments heading into the coming year, after ending its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors.
items.quote: As Raymond James ended its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors - a 2% increase year-over-year, the firm has signaled it expects continued momentum, with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments heading into the coming year.

items.text: Raymond James said the 70 advisors joining its Financial Institutions Division through the Pinnacle/Synovus program expansion are expected to transition in May 2027.
items.quote: The advisors are expected to transition in May 2027.

cells.reason: Passages attribute forward-looking statements about advisor-recruiting momentum and a dated expected advisor transition to the firm; no numeric financial guidance is given.
